WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(orders.ordered_at, MONTH) AS `orders___ordered_at`
  FROM customers AS customers
  LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
    ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC(orders.ordered_at, MONTH)
), _cm_customers___count AS (
  SELECT
    _base.`orders__ordered_at_month` AS `orders__ordered_at_month`,
    COUNT(*) AS `_count_host`
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC(orders.ordered_at, MONTH) AS `orders__ordered_at_month`,
      customers.customer_id AS _ek0
    FROM customers AS customers
    LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
      ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id
    WHERE
      NOT customers.customer_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY
      DATE_TRUNC(orders.ordered_at, MONTH),
      customers.customer_id
  ) AS _base
  GROUP BY
    _base.`orders__ordered_at_month`
)
SELECT
  _base.`orders___ordered_at`,
  COALESCE(_cm_customers___count.`_count_host`, 0) AS `c`
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_customers___count
  ON _base.`orders___ordered_at` IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers___count.`orders__ordered_at_month`
ORDER BY
  _base.`orders___ordered_at` ASC NULLS LAST

WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(customers__orders.ordered_at, MONTH) AS `orders___ordered_at`
  FROM notes AS notes
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON notes.customer_id = customers.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN orders AS customers__orders
    ON customers.customer_id = customers__orders.customer_id
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC(customers__orders.ordered_at, MONTH)
), _cm_notes__amount_sum AS (
  SELECT
    _base.`customers__orders__ordered_at_month` AS `customers__orders__ordered_at_month`,
    CAST(SUM(_base._v) AS FLOAT64) AS `amount_sum_host`
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC(customers__orders.ordered_at, MONTH) AS `customers__orders__ordered_at_month`,
      notes.__slayer_row_id AS _ek0,
      MAX(notes.amount) AS _v
    FROM (

        notes.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS __slayer_row_id

      ON customers.customer_id = customers__orders.customer_id
    WHERE
      NOT notes.__slayer_row_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY
      DATE_TRUNC(customers__orders.ordered_at, MONTH),
      notes.__slayer_row_id
  ) AS _base
  GROUP BY
    _base.`customers__orders__ordered_at_month`
)
SELECT
  _base.`orders___ordered_at`,
  _cm_notes__amount_sum.`amount_sum_host` AS `s`
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_notes__amount_sum
  ON _base.`orders___ordered_at` IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_notes__amount_sum.`customers__orders__ordered_at_month`
ORDER BY
  _base.`orders___ordered_at` ASC NULLS LAST
